segments.ja307:1.1: Acetanaṃ brāhmaṇa assuṇantaṃ, jāno ajānantamimaṃ palāsaṃ;
segments.ja307:1.3: Āraddhaviriyo dhuvaṃ appamatto, sukhaseyyaṃ pucchasi kissa hetu.
segments.ja307:2.1: Dūre suto ceva brahā ca rukkho, dese ṭhito bhūtanivāsarūpo;
segments.ja307:2.3: Tasmā namassāmi imaṃ palāsaṃ, ye cettha bhūtā te [te ca (sī. pī.)] dhanassa hetu.
segments.ja307:3.1: So te karissāmi yathānubhāvaṃ, kataññutaṃ brāhmaṇa pekkhamāno;
segments.ja307:3.3: Kathañhi āgamma sataṃ sakāse, moghāni te assu pariphanditāni.
segments.ja307:4.1: Yo tindukarukkhassa paro [puro (ka.)] pilakkho [pilakkhu (sī. pī.), milakkhu (ka.)], parivārito pubbayañño uḷāro;
segments.ja307:4.3: Tassesa mūlasmiṃ nidhi nikhāto, adāyādo gaccha taṃ uddharāhīti.
